subject: Request: senior clearance for HelixCore hosted API rate concession
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: senior clearance for HelixCore hosted API rate concession

Team —

Quick ask: HelixCore (large medtech customer) wants a final commercial approval for a non-standard Hosted API pricing concession. Summary below and attachments included (MA plan & T&Cs redline).

Why this matters:
- 24-month committed usage (hosted API) with an initial 3-month pilot.
- They propose ~2.4B tokens/month by month 6 (speech-to-text + assistant flows) — modeled ARR ~ $2.1M in year 1 and strong expansion potential.
- They require predictable unit pricing and a single-tier hosted contract (no Dedicated).

Ask:
- Approve a 30% off list Hosted API usage rate for the first 12 months (then step-down to 20% in months 13–24), or signpost an alternate cap. This is >20% so needs senior clearance.
- Approval conditioned on: (1) signed 24-month commitment, (2) SOC-2 + data processing addendum confirmed, (3) prepayment of first 3 months or committed monthly minimum.

Why 30% is justified:
- High initial token volume means the blended unit economics remain positive after batching/kv-cache optimizations; our cost model shows payback in 7 months with their usage ramp.
- Strategic: HelixCore has enterprise integrations into three large hospital systems; strong reference potential for our healthcare GTM.

Risks & mitigations:
- If usage fails to materialize, we require minimum monthly spend floor and right to revert to list rates after a 30-day notice.
- Legal has redlined T&Cs attached; they asked for a single-hosted environment (no data plane handoff).

Attached: HelixCore_MA_plan_Q4.xlsx (usage profile + ramp), T&Cs_redline_v2.pdf

Please advise with signoff language we can send to the customer.

Thanks,
Diego
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: senior clearance for HelixCore hosted API rate concession

Diego —
Quick read: I support the ask given the upside and reference value. Two clarifying items before senior signoff:
1) Is the 2.4B tokens/month a conservative or optimistic projection?
2) Can we include an early-termination fee if they walk before month 12?

If the ramp is conservative + an MTM floor exists, I'm good recommending 30% for the first year.

Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: senior clearance for HelixCore hosted API rate concession

Ben —
Answers:
- The 2.4B figure is conservative; client engineering has capacity to push higher but legal is nervous so they're asking to lock a predictable price. We've stress-tested scenarios in the attached spreadsheet; downside keeps us cash-flow positive with the proposed 3-month prepay + 6-month minimum.
- Early termination: propose a pro-rated termination fee equal to 50% of the remaining committed minimum for months 13–24 if they cancel before month 12; covers our provisioning and on-boarding cost.

If that works I'll ask Legal to bake those clauses into the redline and then request final signoff.

Diego
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: senior clearance for HelixCore hosted API rate concession

Looping Legal (Laura) and Finance implicitly — I want firm language on the minimum monthly commitment + prepay mechanics before I escalate to Rishi for final approval.
Laura — please confirm the proposed termination structure and the prepay language are enforceable and won't create revenue recognition issues. Finance: please confirm this doesn't create an unacceptable AR pattern (heavily front-loaded).

Mina
VP, Sales Operations
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: senior clearance for HelixCore hosted API rate concession

I've reviewed the ask + the mitigations. Approve an initial 30% concession off list Hosted API usage pricing for months 1–12, stepping to 20% for months 13–24, subject to the following absolute conditions:
1) Signed 24-month MSAs executed by HelixCore with Redwood (HubSpot HS-84392 reference).
2) Customer prepays months 1–3 or posts a letter of credit of equivalent value.
3) Redlined T&Cs accepted (Laura to confirm legal signoff before countersignature).
4) Minimum monthly spend floor equal to 40% of the modeled ramp for months 1–6; failure to meet floor triggers a pricing review and potential reversion to list rates.
5) Sales to record special pricing approvals in Deal Desk and tag invoices with deal_id HLX-202611-3.

Approve now. Finance & Legal: please add any mandatory language to the SOW; Sales, proceed to get countersignature.

Rishi
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Reyes <marta.reyes@helixcore.com>, contracts@helixcore.com

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: senior clearance for HelixCore hosted API rate concession

Marta —
Thanks for your patience. Per internal approval (see thread below), Redwood can offer the following: 30% off list Hosted API usage pricing for months 1–12, 20% for months 13–24, contingent on the agreed items below.

Conditions for signature:
- 24-month MSAs countersigned by HelixCore and Redwood (DocuSign link to follow).
- Prepayment of months 1–3 or a letter-of-credit of equal value.
- Acceptance of the attached redlined T&Cs (see T&Cs_redline_v2.pdf).
- Minimum monthly spend floor for months 1–6 equal to 40% of the modeled ramp in the attached MA plan.

If you agree, I'll have our legal team prepare the final SOW and DocuSign envelope — target to close by Nov 30 to secure these commercial terms.

Best,
Diego
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
